query:
SELECT c.id, c.fullName, c.mobileNumber, 
       (SELECT le.balanceAfterUsd FROM ledgerEntries le WHERE le.customerId = c.id ORDER BY le.createdAt DESC LIMIT 1) as balance
FROM customers c
HAVING balance > 0
ORDER BY balance DESC
LIMIT 20;
